data.title: 春寺由梨亚 · 私寓清晨的围裙煎蛋与早安轻唤
data.description: 【春寺由梨亚 · 私寓清晨的围裙煎蛋与早安轻唤】阳光透过白纱帘洒满现代私寓厨房，平底锅里培根煎蛋滋滋作响，手冲现磨黑咖啡香气四溢。摘下眼镜的由梨亚彻底卸下了平日所有的干练防备，长长的蜂蜜金卷发用发夹松松挽起，身上穿一件宽松的大号白衬衫与浅粉色棉质围裙，露出光洁纤细的脚踝与白皙大腿。她手持木质锅铲侧身回头，眼角泪痣微弯，满脸幸福宠溺的笑意轻声唤道——「雄二，醒了吗？快去洗脸漱口，早餐马上就做好了哦。」
data.location: 明亮温馨的现代私寓厨房大理石吧台中岛旁
data.action: 摘下眼镜系着粉色围裙手持锅铲煎蛋，大号白衬衫挽发，回头温柔微笑注视
data.lighting: 清晨温润阳光穿透白纱帘的明亮晨光与咖啡热气光晕
data.camera: medium shot, standing kitchen perspective, focus on bare face, pink apron, and gentle smile
data.promptProse: A heartwarming, sweet domestic slice-of-life anime illustration of Harudera Yuria (JB) from The Fruit of Grisaia preparing breakfast inside a sunlit modern apartment kitchen. Completely without her glasses, her soft sapphire eyes and charming beauty mark beneath her right eye radiate gentle maternal warmth and girlfriend devotion. Her long wavy blonde hair is loosely pinned up with a cute clip, and she wears an oversized white shirt beneath a cozy pastel pink apron over bare legs. Holding a wooden spatula over a sizzling frying pan next to steaming coffee, she turns to smile affectionately with a faint morning blush. Warm morning sunlight pouring through sheer curtains, clean domestic line art, no text.
